host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 && cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 && cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1
cargo test -q -p xtask --test policy && cargo clippy -q --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "struct Finding\|pub struct Finding" -r crates | head -3; cargo build -p athena-core 2>&1 | tail -30
cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -n 20; ls
cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 && cargo test -p athena-core planning 2>&1 | head -n 40

cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy -p athena-core --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 && cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed" ; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "test result"

cargo test -p athena-core >/dev/null 2>&1; echo core=$?; cargo test -p xtask --test policy >/dev/null 2>&1; echo policy=$?; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings >/dev/null 2>&1; echo clippy=$?; cargo fmt --all --check >/dev/null 2>&1; echo fmt=$?
cargo test -q -p xtask --test policy && cargo clippy -q --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check && echo ALLOK
